messages:
oncall-bot: P0 ALERT — post-deploy eviction-rate surge in eu-west shard-pool (deploy r-6734). Symptoms: streaming stalls, increased 504s, token latency spike. Paging on-call. https://internal.monitoring/graph?m=evictions&shard=eu-west-3
Priya: I'm on it, grabbing logs and rollout status.
Sam: rolled adaptive_shard_routing:v2 at ~55% (rollout r-6734) ~5m before spike. It changes shard affinity heuristics.
Priya: can you paste the rollout status and recent logs from shard-proxy?
Sam: rollout status: 55% healthy, no crashloops. logs (tail):
```
2024-06-18T22:00:11 shard-proxy[pid=422]: evict loop latency=120ms evictions=412
2024-06-18T22:00:12 shard-proxy[pid=422]: warn: slot-throttle triggered, kv-cache-miss spikes
2024-06-18T22:00:19 shard-proxy[pid=422]: error: stream deferred, client req_id=abc123, upstream 504
```
Priya: looks like the routing change is causing hot-shard concentrations and cache thrashing -> eviction storm. Plan: 1) flip adaptive_shard_routing flag OFF 2) scale shard-proxy to absorb pressure 3) rollout restart of shard-proxy pods 4) monitor. If not improved, roll back r-6734.
Sam: executing step 1 now. DeployBot, can you confirm feature flag and stop further rollout?
DeployBot: Rollout r-6734 paused. Feature flag adaptive_shard_routing set to OFF by Sam at 1799991280. CI link: https://ci/internal/rollouts/r-6734
Priya: commands I'm running (copy):
```
# flip feature flag
cg-ctl feature-flip --env prod --id adaptive_shard_routing --set OFF
# scale shard-proxy
kubectl scale deploy/shard-proxy -n prod --replicas=12
# restart to clear hot state
kubectl rollout restart deploy/shard-proxy -n prod
```
Sam: flip done, scale + restart in progress.
customer-support: seeing ~14 support threads from EU customers about long stalls/504s. Notified account teams for top 3.
Priya: monitoring: eviction-rate EU-west3: pre-mitigation peak ~420 evictions/s, 504 rate ~1.2% of requests; after flag flip and scale (observed at 1799991325) eviction-rate dropped to ~28/s and 504s down to 0.08%. Latency back to baseline for most streams.
Marta: I am coming onshift in 10m for handoff, will take the incident. Please leave a short summary and what to watch.
Priya: summary for handoff -> rolled adaptive_shard_routing:v2 to 55% caused hot-shard cache thrash -> flipped feature flag OFF at 1799991280, scaled shard-proxy to 12 replicas, restarted pods. Metrics normalized within ~2m after actions. Customer impact: transient streaming stalls and 504s for ~7 minutes; roughly 1.2% of requests affected at peak; 14 tickets opened. Actions to follow: observe for 30m, if eviction-rate creeps >50/s or 504s >0.5% initiate full rollback of r-6734 and open postmortem.
Jason: added follow-up: create rollback run and block re-rollout until patch to routing heuristic merges (assign to eng-ml). I'll schedule a rollback window if metrics trend back up within 20m.
oncall-bot: handoff note — Priya -> Marta; incident marked HANDOFF at 1799991360.
Marta: ack, thanks @Priya. I'm monitoring dashboards and tracing live. Added runbook note: https://internal.runbooks/shard-eviction. I'll update incident channel every 10m or on change.
ops-rotation: leaving note: if you need extra capacity quickly, we can spin an autoscale group for shard-proxy in eu-west3, but prefer config fixes first.
customer-support: we'll send a short update to affected customers: apology + mitigation summary + ETA for root cause and postmortem.
Priya: leaving done: added perf traces and logs to the incident doc, will draft RCA once we confirm fix durability. :thumbsup:
Marta: handing over to night ops; if anything degrades, page me directly and I'll escalate.
oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Escalation quiet window until 1799992050.
